propositions: Identity convention (JiraIdentityConvention) and pure probe classifier logic must relocate from adapters/jira/ to a new jira_family package, with shared symbols exported publicly so DC adapter can reuse them without cross-adapter imports.

Sanitizers and value maps split across jira_fields.py: outright moves of _sanitize_label/_sanitize_summary/InvalidLabelError/_RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK and map literals to jira_family; contract-parameterized moves of _sanitize_description/_sanitize_comment and classify_probe_response, receiving codec and limit dependencies injected rather than imported.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py, outbound_fields.py) must not move; they are shared by dependency inversion — importing jira_family contracts, never the reverse — so adapters/jira remains below jira_family in the import graph per ADR 0035.

Single canonical dict literals for _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA and _LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA must exist only in adapters/jira_family; Cloud ACLI and backend both import from that sole site, eliminating the pre-existing drift (deleted key adopts Done from outbound_fields).
Absolute imports (never relative) of jira_family symbols must be used in pinned modules loaded via spec_from_file_location with synthetic names; relative imports fail when __package__ is empty.

All internal importers (acli.py, acli_cli_ops.py, backend.py, test fixtures) and mock.patch strings must be re-pointed to new paths in the same commit with no re-export shims left behind; J1's test oracle import lines are updated (one import re-point for _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK) while assertions remain verbatim.
